paragraphs: I’m Muhammad Hasan Rabbani, an Informatics student at Universitas Pembangunan Nasional “Veteran” Yogyakarta. I’m interested in full-stack web development and I’m looking for an internship as a Web Developer, whether in frontend, backend or UI/UX.

I build web applications with JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express and databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL. Some projects I’ve worked on: a beauty and wellness clinic information system, an electric battery inventory management system, a movie information system and this portfolio site.

Outside class, I’m active in student organisations as a staff member of the Arts & Sports Division of BEM FTI and as a staff member of the FTI CUP 2025 committee. There I learned to work in a team and to manage my time.
